title: ARB RED Commit Witness Receipt
description: The verdict of `gz arb red --commit`: each production hunk a commit added, reverted and swept against the test modules the same commit touched (GHI #927). Written so the verdict a GHI close cites can be resolved (GHI #1152).

git.description: Git context of the working tree that ran the witness.

verdict.description: Aggregate verdict: driven = every hunk killed; undriven = a hunk survived; no-tests = the commit touched no test module; no-production-hunks = nothing to mutate; inconclusive = a hunk could not be graded.

detail.description: Why the verdict, when it is not per-hunk.

test_modules.description: Dotted test modules the sweep ran.

hunks.description: One entry per mutated production hunk, or per guard statement of a hunk whose whole revert could not be graded.

unit.description: What was reverted: the whole hunk; one guard statement of a hunk whose whole revert could not be graded; or such a hunk holding no guard statement, which stays outside the aggregate verdict (GHI #1153). Absent in receipts written before it existed.

exit_status.description: Exit status `gz arb red --commit` returned for this verdict.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the witness run.
